institute.label: Institute Overview
institute.title: About the Institute
institute.desc: The Goyang Culture Tourism & MICE Research Institute is a specialized platform established to strategically develop Goyang's culture, tourism, exhibition, convention, and events industries, and to connect them to city branding and local economic outcomes.
institute.leadershipQuote: Urban competitiveness is built when policy research and on-the-ground execution go hand in hand
institute.leadershipDesc: The Institute goes beyond strategic proposals — we aspire to be an action-oriented think tank that connects Goyang's assets to industry outcomes and tangible results.

research.label: Research Areas
research.title: Research Areas
research.desc: The Institute conducts research through an interdisciplinary lens that bridges city branding and local economy with international events and the tourism industry.
research.processDesc: An integrated research methodology that simultaneously examines feasibility and real-world applicability.
research.reportsDesc: Browse the Institute's major research outputs and policy briefs.
research.commissionDesc: We welcome research commissions, policy advisory requests, and consulting inquiries in the culture tourism and MICE fields.

dmc.label: DMC Services
dmc.title: DMC Services
dmc.desc: The affiliated Goyang DMC Center provides end-to-end on-site operational services for corporate events, international conferences, incentive tours, FAM tours, VIP programs, and more — from planning through completion.
dmc.processDesc: A dedicated team accompanies every step from initial consultation to final reporting.
dmc.partnersDesc: We deliver integrated services through a broad network of institutions and vendors.
